build_PositionEncodingSine: build a PositionEncodingSine module to add 2D sinusoidal position encoding to feature maps
create_LinearAttention: create a LinearAttention module for fast multi-head linear attention with ELU feature mapping
create_FullAttention: create a FullAttention module for standard multi-head scaled dot-product attention with optional dropout
build_LoFTREncoderLayer: build a LoFTREncoderLayer transformer encoder with configurable linear or full attention and feed-forward network
build_LocalFeatureTransformer: build a LocalFeatureTransformer module with self and cross attention layers for feature matching
